heroHeadline: Cloud, Chips, and Capital: Quantinuum-Oracle Deal, Nighthawk r2 and Superion 256 Mark a Fast August–September for Quantum Computing
heroSubtitle: Aug 12–Sep 8, 2026: Quantinuum partners with Oracle to bring Helios (near-five-nines logical fidelity) to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure; Cornell halves the deposition temperature for tantalum superconducting qubits; IBM ships the 120-qubit Nighthawk r2 with 25x circuit throughput; PsiQuantum finalizes a $100M CHIPS Act award; and IonQ unveils its 256-qubit Superion platform
footerNote: Data sourced from APS, Nobel Prize archive, Nature, Physical Review, Niels Bohr Archive, Bell Labs, CERN, IBM Quantum, Google Quantum AI, NIST, IonQ, Quantinuum, QuEra, Q-CTRL, Origin Quantum, ScienceDaily
